code: import{createSlice,createAsyncThunk}from'@reduxjs/toolkit';import api from'../../services/api';export const loginUser=createAsyncThunk('auth/login',async(credentials,_ref)=>{let{rejectWithValue}=_ref;try{const res=await api.post('/auth/login',credentials);localStorage.setItem('nipix_token',res.data.token);return res.data;}catch(err){return rejectWithValue(err.response.data);}});const authSlice=createSlice({name:'auth',initialState:{user:null,token:localStorage.getItem('nipix_token'),loading:false,error:null},reducers:{logout:state=>{state.user=null;state.token=null;localStorage.removeItem('nipix_token');}},extraReducers:builder=>{builder.addCase(loginUser.pending,state=>{state.loading=true;}).addCase(loginUser.fulfilled,(state,action)=>{state.loading=false;state.user=action.payload.user;state.token=action.payload.token;}).addCase(loginUser.rejected,(state,action)=>{state.loading=false;state.error=action.payload;});}});export const{logout}=authSlice.actions;export default authSlice.reducer;
